text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap's hometown friends come to an exhibition race to show their support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's thrilled by the unexpected reunion, but her friends overhear some inconsiderate remarks from other audience members.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She heads to the track, determined to put her supporters' minds at ease.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She dominates the race, pulling off an impressive victory.
